summary:
This article is about enemies who are werewolves. For the condition lycanthropy, in particular the effects it has on you, see Werewolf. Summoned by Pentarch Draljura
The Feral Gallery Werewolves are monstrous, half-man, half-wolf hybrid creatures. They are taller and broader than man and mer, and are capable of moving on two limbs or sprinting on all four. They have a weakness to poisons, but are incredibly strong, and very fast. Some werewolves, often through alchemical or magical augmentation, can evolve into behemoths. Players can become a werewolf if infected. This unlocks the ability to transform, as well as an associated Lycanthropy skill line. For more information, see the lore page.
